name: carbon-solana
description: Carbon Solana indexing framework reference. Pipeline, datasources, decoders, processors, and per-protocol instruction/account/event schemas for 60+ Solana programs (Raydium, Pumpfun, Meteora, Orca, Jupiter, Drift, Kamino, Phoenix, etc.). Wires rust-analyzer as the LSP for .rs files. Prereq: rust-analyzer on PATH (`mise use rust-analyzer@latest`).
